brief.headline: Qualify a stronger second source (Mold-Tek or Manjushree) and ask for a 10–15% price cut to the ₹0.65–0.80/pc band the market says is achievable at volume.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut of 10–15% to land in the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range for the 28 mm PP cap
priceAsk.basis: The market ask for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend gives us volume leverage to push into that lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 Days After Receipt terms

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or cash position. That means we lean on our own buying power and on lining up a credible second source. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend is material for a private converter, and we have four strong alternates ready to qualify. Without visibility into their finances, we should push firmly on price but balance it by keeping payment terms steady and making clear we want a long-term partner — not a one-sided squeeze.

evidence.point: We spend ₹63.21 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging
The market asking price for a 28 mm PP cap is typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume
HDPE resin import unit value is 87.61 ₹/kg, giving us a raw-material benchmark
We currently pay them 30 Days After Receipt, which is reasonable and frees up no extra cash if we tighten

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (private, ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter with pharma bottles, caps and preforms — top second-source candidate with scale and solid health

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (listed, ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader in pails, containers and pharma packaging — robust, profitable and a strong alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Resin manufacturer in India-Pan; could bypass converters if we move upstream, though needs qualification for pharma-grade moulding

risks: Bprex's financials are not public, so we can't gauge their cash position or ability to absorb a price cut — watch for any signal they're stretched and adjust the push accordingly.
Pushing too hard without a qualified second source in hand could leave us scrambling if they walk away; line up Manjushree or Mold-Tek quotes before the final ask.
The market-ask verdict says the price is already market-fair, so frame the 10–15% ask around our volume and long-term commitment, not as correcting an overcharge.
Our current 30-day terms are reasonable and freeing up no extra cash, so we have no payment-term lever to trade — the negotiation rides entirely on price and the credible threat of a second source.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹63.21 L a year with you, and we'd like to deepen that partnership — but we need your price to come down to the ₹0.65–0.80 range the market says is doable at our volume, and we're qualifying Manjushree and Mold-Tek as second sources to de-risk supply.
